verdict.rationale: Document QnA combines OCR with an LLM so users can extract information and insights from their documents by asking natural-language questions, including multi-document queries and comparisons. Annotations add AI-generated structured extraction and figure descriptions or captions. missing for 10: proactive AI suggestions or recommendations (only user-prompted Q&A is documented), any in-product UI experience beyond the API, and independent or hands-on corroboration of the QnA and insight features (community evidence covers only OCR accuracy).
